summary: Stop hosted subagents on the Claude subscription route from failing with "wrote no row for a signed block of the response" when the model writes for a long time after it thinks.

key_files: src/orchestration/modules/provider-claude-agent-sdk/agent-host/agent-bridge.ts: the hosted agent's stream() wrapper and the adapter request options
src/orchestration/modules/provider-claude-agent-sdk/agent-host/agent-stream.ts: hostedStreamEvents re-encodes one hosted step as Anthropic stream events
src/orchestration/modules/provider-claude-agent-sdk/agent-host/agent-file.ts: AgentRows reads the engine's rows of signed blocks
patterns: Stream failures that a retry can fix are LlmStreamError with kind "transient".
The shared Anthropic adapter ends a response whose reasoning stalls past its deadline unless the transport reports progress through StreamOptions.onProgress.
constraints: Hosted subagents on the Claude subscription route fail with "The Anthropic Subscription agent host wrote no row for a signed block of the response" when the model thinks and then writes for more than about ten seconds. One benchmark experiment lost 326 responses this way. Make these responses complete.

The engine writes the signed row of each thinking block within moments of that block's end, as the ROW_BOUND_MS comment states. The ten-second bound is simply too tight for slow disks, so the bound is the only defect.

Keep the exported signature hostedStreamEvents(events, rows, from, model, failure, onAnswer, onProgress), where onProgress is a new seventh parameter of type () => void; acceptance tests call it with exactly these seven arguments.
Anthropic event order must hold: a thinking block's signature_delta and content_block_stop come before any event of a later block.

milestones.goal: Give the engine enough time to write a signed block's row and report the wait as progress.

tasks.description: In agent-bridge.ts, where the hosted stream waits for the row of a signed block, raise ROW_BOUND_MS from 10_000 to 60_000 so that a slow write after thinking fits inside the bound. Update the comment to say the engine writes the row within a minute of the block's end.
test_scenarios: A response that writes for 30 seconds after its thinking completes.
A response whose row never arrives still fails transient with "wrote no row".

tasks.description: Add the onProgress parameter to hostedStreamEvents and call it on every poll while the stream waits for a row, so that the adapter's thinking-stall deadline does not end a response while its row is pending. Pass () => { options.onProgress?.(); } from agent-bridge.ts.
test_scenarios: A response that generates past the adapter's reasoning deadline while a row is pending completes.
A response that stops sending chunks still fails as a thinking stall.

milestones.qualitative_verification: The longer bound and the progress reports are the only behavior change.

success_criteria: A hosted response streams completely however long the model writes after its thinking, in Anthropic event order, with each thinking block's signature or redacted data from the engine's row.
A signed row that is still missing after the step's stop chunk fails transient with "wrote no row"; a step that ends without a stop chunk fails with the service's answer.
A response that keeps producing chunks is not ended as a thinking stall while it waits for a row, and a response that stops producing chunks still is.
The existing hosted agent tests pass.
